metadata.case_name: LI TING CHUN AND ANOTHER v. LI TING FAI

source: there is no doubt he sustained serious brain injuries in that crash
The only lasting damage which the 1st plaintiff has suffered has been to his brain.

injuries.description: a fracture of the right zygoma
source: He had one laceration of 3½" and another of 2" over the right side of his face, a fracture of the right zygoma and abrasion over the dorsum of his right hand and right shin.

injuries.description: lacerations of 3½" and 2" over the right side of his face (facial lacerations)
source: He had one laceration of 3½" and another of 2" over the right side of his face, a fracture of the right zygoma and abrasion over the dorsum of his right hand and right shin. A tracheotomy was performed on him and his facial lacerations sutured.
injuries.icd_description: Laceration without foreign body of head

manifestations.description: gross intellectual and personality deterioration; left with the mental age of a young child
personality deterioration including unpredictability of moods and irritability
reduced ability to enjoy ordinary social life; prospects of enjoying an ordinary social life have ceased to exist
heavily dependent on his wife; requires supervision and constant care and attention; wife has to wash him and remind him to eat and drink
urinary incontinence for a while after discharge
gets no pleasure from his children's company; dislikes them and throws things at them

Requires supervision and constant care and attention; wife must remind him to eat and drink and wash him
